method: Public publisher terms and repository implementation audit only.

items.resource: ESV Bible reader and keyword search
risks: Non-commercial site and use required; site must not primarily solicit donations, sales or advertising
ESV wording must not be altered; 500 verse/half-book limits and daily/hourly/minute query caps
Full copyright notice and ESV.org link required wherever text is displayed
Published API key response confirms provider service, not grant scope or continuing account status
items.nextEvidence: Continue checking Crossway public attribution, server API use and display limits against the implementation.

risks: Standard versus unique licence and publisher terms depend on the active API.Bible app plan
Approved Bible ID and live response do not by themselves prove the operator accepted the licence
Copyright must display next to every passage; FUMS reporting required
items.nextEvidence: Validate reader and Atlas display against published API.Bible/Lockman attribution, FUMS and usage requirements.

risks: Biblica express licensing restricts qualifying free use to genuinely non-commercial applications without AI/ML features
API.Bible express/commercial availability and territory depend on translation and agreement
Publisher notice must display for each passage and FUMS is required
items.nextEvidence: Validate NIV display, Biblica attribution, passage limits and non-commercial reader functionality against published terms.

risks: API.Bible September 2026 NKJV availability restriction for Starter/Pro non-commercial applications: 5,000 monthly end users maximum
Exceeding this audience threshold requires ceasing NKJV or a suitable commercial plan/licence
Publisher copyright notices, FUMS and translation-specific plan permissions apply
items.nextEvidence: Monitor public usage limits and provider availability for the non-commercial site; preserve notices and reporting.

items.resource: Locally imported cross-reference links and relevance votes
risks: OpenBible.info identifies a Creative Commons Attribution licence for its material but the reference datasets include components drawn from other sources
OpenBible.info attribution does not grant permission to redistribute Crossway ESV verse text
Snapshot provenance and exact licence version should be archived; existing attribution claims CC BY 4.0
items.nextEvidence: Retain dated source snapshot, upstream attribution/license record and transformation ledger; separately re-check original source licence if its scope changes.

items.resource: Five locally hosted contemporary city photographs
risks: CC BY-SA images require appropriate credit, licence reference and change disclosure and may impose ShareAlike requirements on adaptations
A Wikimedia Commons page's current licence statement may change or have source-specific conditions
Some imagery is marked public domain and is not automatically covered by other photographs' licences
items.nextEvidence: Verify each original Commons file page's author, source and licence and retain evidence of transforms, URLs and exact SHA-256 bytes.
